name: Exact Title Search for Admin Pages
author: samairali

sections.description:
This plugin enhances the search functionality in the WordPress admin Pages section. When you search for a page, it first tries to find an exact match for the page title. If no exact match is found, it falls back to partial title matching.

Perfect for large sites with dozens or hundreds of pages, this plugin helps you find the page you’re looking for — faster and more accurately — right from the admin panel.

✅ Instantly search WordPress pages by exact title in the admin area with smart autocomplete suggestions.

🎯 Get Exact Title Search Pro →
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. No additional configuration is required.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work for posts or custom post types?

Currently, this plugin only affects the search behavior in the WordPress admin Pages section. The Pro version adds instant smart autocomplete for quicker access.

short_description: A lightweight plugin that improves the admin page search by prioritizing exact title matches, with fallback to partial matches.
